title: The Unbinding
summary: You told one levyman in the Amber Downs what the oath-stone was actually doing to him. Words travel further than people do.

objectives.text: Teach a levyman how the charm-work was done to him
Find where the telling got to

title: The Whole Road
summary: The last caravanner gave you the southern half of a route that dies with him. Somebody has been keeping the northern half alive the entire time.

objectives.text: Learn the Dustreach route from the last man who has it
Find where the road picks up again

title: The Gardener
summary: Fresh flowers at a nameless stone in the Hollow Mire, from a stand two days' walk away that somebody tends. There is a second stand, and it is older.

objectives.text: Track the flowers to their source

title: Provenance
summary: The under-librarian fetched you a book from six feet of water and it came back dry, with a provenance slip that names a mountain instead of a person.

objectives.text: Request a book from the unrelieved librarian
Stand where the slip says the book came from

title: One Day Ahead
summary: Somebody ran your route through the Crags a day in front of you, took only what they could carry, and re-covered every cache. You over-stocked the next one to see what would happen.

objectives.text: Trade with the runner through the caches
Find their notation somewhere it has no business being

title: The Same Gait
summary: A woman walks barefoot across warm stone in the Obsidian Waste and her feet do not burn. She is not the only one.

objectives.text: Walk the warm stone with the pilgrim

title: Leave a Mark
summary: The gap report's charge against the encounter layer was that it behaves like a vending machine: coin in, coin out, nothing left behind. Prove otherwise in three places.

objectives.text: Leave something permanent behind in the world

title: A Deep World
summary: Seven marks, in seven situations that did not have to go the way they went.

objectives.text: Leave permanent marks across the world

title: The World Remembers
summary: Twelve. At this point the map is not a place you pass through.

objectives.text: Leave permanent marks across the world
